source.company_summary: For decades, due to the challenge of timely managing very large amounts of data, manufacturing analytics often functioned as an overlay in the semiconductor industry: though powerful, it was disconnected from direct execution.
product_stack: validating compliance with the GEM and GEM300 standards
validating compliance with the EDA/Interface A standards
customer_types: Fortune 500 companies that use our products
core_technologies: Such aligned data can then be analyzed with our machine learning (ML)
This module provides failure detection and classification (FDC)
It is designed to jump from one device under test (DUT)

ai_exposure.summary: We have taken advantage of advances in agentic AI to also help make the tens of thousands of experiments and billions of measurements per wafer of our advanced CV test chips more accessible, including by enabling customers to interpret complex datasets and generate insights quickly on demand. ● AI-Ready Data Platform.

strategy_changes.change: Recognizing that current analytics architectures hit fundamental limits around 20,000 parameters, while newer semiconductor devices and chiplet products routinely generate millions, in 2024, we began work to completely reimagine our analytics platform to be able to handle the extremely large data volume typical of the semiconductor industry.

In 2020, we expanded our portfolio with Cimetrix products via acquisition, which products are a leading software for connectivity and control of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and in 2025, nearly 8,000 pieces of semiconductor manufacturing equipment shipped with Cimetrix products enabled.

ai_exposure.summary: 我們已利用 agentic AI 的進展，幫助使每片晶圓上先進 CV 測試晶片的數萬次實驗與數十億次測量更易接近，包括讓客戶能即時解釋複雜資料集並快速生成洞察。● AI-Ready Data Platform。

strategy_changes.change: 認識到現有分析架構在約 20,000 個參數時達到根本極限，而新型半導體裝置及 chiplet 產品常產生數百萬參數，2024 年我們開始重新構想分析平台，以處理半導體產業典型的極大量資料。
2020 年，我們透過收購擴展了 Cimetrix 產品系列，該產品為半導體製造設備連接與控制的領先軟體，且在 2025 年，近 8,000 台半導體製造設備出貨時已啟用 Cimetrix 產品。
